responsibility: This file implements SPARC-specific gcc driver support for -mcpu=native and -mtune=native. It probes the host processor brand string via Solaris kstat or Linux /proc/cpuinfo, maps detected CPU names to GCC SPARC cpu option names such as ultrasparc3, niagara4, niagara7, or m8, and returns replacement driver specs consumed by EXTRA_SPEC_FUNCTIONS in the Linux-target headers.
